question: Chinese paper-money milestones se fiat era tak kya sequence diya hai?
essence: Receipts → state notes → compulsory use → modern fiat: book yeh selected sequence dikhati hai.
answer: 7th century mein Tang ke saath receipts, 1023 mein Song ke saath state notes, aur 1275 mein Yuan ke saath 'Compulsory' label diya hai. 1971 ko modern fiat era dikhaya gaya hai. In labels se aage institutional details book ke supplied text mein nahi hain. [p004]
